$schema.description: The JSON Schema version used for this schema.

title.description: The title of the user property

x-identifier.description: Whether this property is an identifier for the user or not

x-verify.description: The verification method for this property, if applicable

x-unique.description: The level of uniqueness for this property, if applicable

x-claim.description: The claim name for this property, if applicable

x-editable.description: Whether this property is editable by the user or not

x-sensitive.description: Whether this property contains sensitive information or not

x-mfa.description: Whether this property is used for multi-factor authentication or not

properties.description: A map of additional properties for the user definition, where the key is the property name and the value is the property schema
